sections.title: Your scans stay on this iPhone until you send one
sections.body: Ayna makes network requests only when you pair this iPhone with Ayna or tap Send to Ayna. Scans are not sent anywhere else, and diagnostics are never sent. There is no advertising, analytics or tracking.

sections.title: What the app saves
sections.body: When you scan, Ayna uses the camera and LiDAR to save room geometry, photos, depth frames, camera poses and a tracking map on the device, plus the device model, system version and technical diagnostics such as tracking errors and memory or thermal conditions. Photos and geometry can reveal private details of your surroundings.

sections.title: Sharing
sections.body: Nothing is shared automatically. When you use Share .zip, iOS sends the archive to the app, device or person you choose. Review the destination before sharing; copies you share are not removed when you delete the mirror.

sections.title: Send to Ayna
sections.body: Send to Ayna uploads only the mirror you choose, when you choose it: its room layout, LiDAR mesh, posed photos (including the hero shot), depth frames and the device model. It goes to the Ayna server set in the app (ayna-scan.vercel.app unless you change it) and is linked to the Ayna account you paired with. Pairing sends the code from the website and this iPhone's name; the server's token is kept in the Keychain on this iPhone only. You can unpair from Pairing with Ayna in a mirror's menu. Deleting a mirror on the iPhone does not delete a copy that was sent.

sections.title: Storage and deletion
sections.body: Mirrors are stored in the app's Documents folder, also visible in the Files app, and may be included in your device backups. Delete mirror removes a mirror's local files permanently. Temporary ZIP files made for sharing are removed after the share sheet closes; the copy made for Send to Ayna is removed when its upload ends.

sections.title: Permissions
sections.body: Camera access is requested when you start a scan and can be revoked in Settings. Ayna does not request access to Contacts, location, the microphone or the Photos library.
